name: Bara no Choukyou Monogatari
source:
The rose has finally returned! Feel free to use any items or techniques on the beautiful young girl who confesses to you, and to complete your own color. Whether or not the beautiful rose of the young girl's love is like a flower blooming in a garden of paradise is entirely up to you... Be careful of making her pregnant.
